text:
```yaml
name: Auto Assign Milestone

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [closed]
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release/**'
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

jobs:
  auto_assign_milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Install policy-bot-action
        run: npm install @microsoft/policy-bot-action

      - name: Run policy-bot-action
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          npx policy-bot-action --config .github/policies/milestoneAssignment.prClosed.yml
```
